nodes.note: Order-level internal relationships are intentionally left as a polytomy in v1.
Stiller et al. 2024 recovered this relationship in the main tree, but reported substantial non-local uncertainty.
New clade named by Stiller et al. 2024. Internal deep relationships are represented as a polytomy in v1 because Opisthocomiformes, Strisores and Phaethontimorphae show substantial discordance.
Used here as the owl + New World vulture + hawk/eagle grouping in the current synthesis.
Stiller et al. 2024 supports an Afroaves/Australaves split within Telluraves, while some deep afroavian branches remain difficult.
Four major clades follow Stiller et al. 2024. Their earliest divergences are rapid and some alternative topologies retain genomic support.
